decisions.reason: As an organic extension of the core salami range that remained listed across 2023 and 2024, it fits the announced assortment strategy and prior launch effort makes management likely to continue backing it.

Although support appears to have softened from a dedicated page to a general mention, it is still close to the core business and management can justify weaker traction as temporary rather than abandon a visible premium launch quickly.
This 2024 organic sausage launch received its own page and directly supports the firm's stated expansion of organic lines, so recent investment and public commitment favor continuation.
The new organic chicken-breast variants are prominently presented, align with the ingredient-conscious organic direction, and are too new for management to judge harshly after one season.

This new organic salami variant sits very near the established offer and the firm's organic growth path, so management is likely to persist unless results become clearly and persistently disappointing.
